notes: THE SYMPOSIUM -- friends, and a whole new look. FRIENDS: search a player by name, send a request, and once they accept tap INVITE to drop straight into a battle together -- no addresses, no setup, works anywhere. The whole home screen is rebuilt: every button is a real object now with proper depth, lighting and its own colour. One BATTLE button -- big half fights, small half picks difficulty or multiplayer. GUILDS is back on the bottom bar and REWARDS moved up top. A win streak flag hangs under your name, chests sit in real stone sockets, and the REWARDS page has a new TREASURY card. Plus Shield Hoplites got real hand-drawn artwork in all four directions.
